mechanics_scope: standard_soccar; detect team size; flag alternate modes and mutators

calibration.coordinate_convention: normalized x0,y0,x1,y1 relative to detected game viewport
calibration.seed_status: hypothetical; detect anchors and calibrate per layout span

roles.restriction: Keep series and match score separate; score delta alone does not identify scorer.

roles.broadcast_policy: locate sidebars and active-player tag dynamically
roles.restriction: Every boost observation belongs to an identified player or unresolved HUD track; rebind after switches.
Absent ball-cam indicator does not establish disabled ball cam; camera motion is not world motion.

roles.crop_policy: temporally stable union of relevant car/ball/surface tracks with padding and source transforms
roles.restriction: Do not infer exact controls; crop must contain the relationship needed for the claim.

roles.crop_policy: entire unmasked gameplay viewport at reduced resolution plus detailed active-area crops
roles.restriction: Missing/off-screen players are unknown; do not assume possession or empty goal from absence.
Separate credited events from visually resolved mechanics.

confidence_policy: Model self-confidence is not calibrated acceptance quality; repeated extraction of the same pixels is not independent evidence.
graph_policy: Overlapping intervals and multiple parents are allowed; temporal adjacency does not establish intent or causality.

sampling_pilot_hypotheses.fast_event_policy: Review native-rate frames around ambiguity or reject precise timing/order; source quality can make events irrecoverable.
sampling_pilot_hypotheses.discovery_absence_policy: Sparse sampling absence never proves an event did not occur.

segmentation_policy: Evidence requirements override durations; link longer parent episodes and overlapping children; preserve missing footage and avoid transitive merging.
question_acceptance_rules: Verify every answer claim against timestamped source evidence, independently of captions.
Resolve necessary identities or phrase questions using supported tracks/teams.
Bind boost readings to player identity and require freshness.
Require sufficient setup/contact/outcome context for the question.
Reject exact chronological order when uncertainty intervals overlap.
Keep observed touch, credited stat and inferred tactical labels distinct.
Do not equate last touch or next touch with possession.
Deduplicate replayed goals/events and split datasets by match.
Do not assert exact controls, unseen positions/resources, intent, or unsupported causality.
Qualify claims by visible scope; missing players do not establish negative facts.
Verify each multiple-choice alternative for ambiguity and label chronology when outcomes are sequential.
Keep optional audio answers out of a video-only benchmark.
Withhold future evidence beyond the observation cutoff for prediction tasks.
Preserve deliberately unanswerable questions and rejected-candidate reasons.
